purpose: Document independent city-specific registry source review and bounded anonymous geometry access investigation.
assessment: Exact point intersection query requested `outFields=OBJECTID` only, geometry and EPSG:4326 output, result limit 3. It returned one Polygon; an independent ring test confirms the unchanged WUP point lies inside and the ring is closed. The sample retains OBJECTID and unchanged geometry only.\nExact request: https://sisurb.pjf.mg.gov.br/server/rest/services/uso_cad_lotes/MapServer/158/query?f=geojson&where=1%3D1&geometry=-43.3632723968038%2C-21.7520452174457&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&inSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&outFields=OBJECTID&returnGeometry=true&outSR=4326&resultRecordCount=3\nResult: HTTP 200; one polygon, OBJECTID 70049; unchanged locator contained inside.
registryAssessment: The municipal SISURB lot service is explicitly described as registered municipal lots compiled from city and consortium cadastral datasets. Its public polygon layer returned an exact WUP-point intersecting feature, OBJECTID 70049.
